settings.title: Settings
settings.smartCropHint:
Zooms in on the moving part before recognizing it, so people and objects look clearer;
recommended at the same resolution.
settings.omniFpsHint: Higher reacts faster but uses more resources.
settings.perceptionInputHint: Images are more accurate; video is cheaper.
settings.imageLastFrameOnlyHint:
On: one frame at the end — fast and cheap, enough for “is someone there”;
Off: the whole clip — steadier for actions and gestures.
settings.perceptionInputVideoNote: The next option applies to images only.
settings.perceptionVerboseHint:
On: every rule says matched or not, and why — handy for troubleshooting;
Off (default): only which rules matched — faster and cheaper.
settings.minUrgencyHint: Lower-priority events are still logged — they just won’t buzz you.
settings.globalPromptHint: Appended as-is to the end of the system prompt, for every camera. Write your own headings inside the text for sections.
settings.globalPromptPlaceholder:
# Household notes

- Watch for packages at the door
- Ignore the TV screen
- No alerts while someone is home
settings.autoScheduleHint:
Lets miloco run daily checks, tidy memories and summarize habits;
turning it off deletes those tasks. Applies after Agent restart.
settings.slimModelHint: Scene checks need a multimodal model. Set one up and enable it on the Models page, or nothing will run.
settings.partialSaveFailed: Scheduled tasks saved, but perception settings didn't. Please retry.
settings.restartFailed: Saved, but the engine didn't restart. Please restart miloco.
settings.schedulerSaved: Saved. Takes effect after Agent restart.
